title: Caveman eval grader registry
description: Machine-readable description of every grader type the eval taxonomy accepts. Drives the dashboard grader editor; the two parity tests (public/evals/tests/grader-registry.parity.runtime.mjs and cloud/optimizer/tests/test_grader_registry_parity.py) hold it to the implementations.

version.description: Registry schema version; bump when an entry field is added, removed or changes meaning.

type.description: Wire name sent as the grader type; must be a member of the Python GRADER_TYPES set.

title.description: Short human name for a list or a form heading.

category.description: Grouping for the editor; unknown values are rejected rather than defaulted.

description.description: One sentence in plain operator voice saying what passes and what fails.

scored.description: True when the Python service reports a graded score; false when the score is only 1.0 on pass and 0.0 on fail.

deterministic.description: True when the same input always yields the same verdict; false for the judge family and for custom_webhook, whose verdict comes from an outside system.

judge_calls.description: Judge-model calls one grade costs: 0 for every non-judge type, 1 for the judge family, 2 for llm_pairwise, which asks both orderings.

legacy.description: True for a grader kept for existing suites and not offered for new ones.

python_only.description: True when only the Python grade service implements the type; the TypeScript package fails it closed as an unknown grader.

prompt_template.description: Judge family only: the pinned prompt both implementations send, byte for byte, with {name} markers for the interpolated values. A byte contract, not documentation.

options.description: JSON Schema for that type's option bag, ground-truthed from the two implementations.
